selection: All 79 already-screened sector86 camera4 CCD4 observations, including target; selection frozen before viewing controls.
limitations: Selected event and fixed time; not a survey false-alarm probability.
Stars can have independent real transits/variability at this time. Shared trends require assessment of depth, morphology and background, not simply a count.
Native local polynomial uses residual diagonal errors; correlated noise incomplete.

corrected.warning: Same-detector median control is an exploratory explanatory trend, with target excluded. Its subtraction does not calibrate correlated-noise uncertainty or prove instrumentality.
